description: This file defines an internal interface for a worker involved in activation rebalancing within Orleans. It includes method signatures for retrieving reports, and suspending or resuming rebalancing activities.

classes.name: IActivationRebalancerWorker
classes.description: An internal interface defining operations for an activation rebalancer worker, including getting reports and controlling rebalancing activities.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent rebalancing report and acts as a wake-up call for the rebalancer if it is deactivated.

methods.name: ResumeRebalancing
methods.description: Resumes rebalancing if it is currently suspended; otherwise, it performs no operation.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Suspends rebalancing for a specified duration, or indefinitely if null.
